title: Wisdom-Driven Knowledge Augmented Generation at Scale - Chin Keong Lam, Patho AI
talk_summary: A consultant describes building 'wisdom graph' knowledge-augmented generation systems for clients: a taxonomy of knowledge/experience/insight/situation nodes feeding a supervisory 'wisdom agent' that orchestrates sub-agents which each update a shared central graph. The actionable core is a shared structured graph as the coordination substrate between agents, plus hybrid LLM-extraction-then-expert-pruning of the graph.

takeaways.technique: Shared central graph as multi-agent coordination substrate
takeaways.what_they_do: Each specialized sub-agent writes its own perspective/portion into one unified central knowledge graph, and a supervisory 'wisdom agent' reads the whole graph to decide next actions, instead of agents passing free-text messages.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the central graph will be able to get updated by different agent ... inside agent will update the their perspective like part of that graph

takeaways.technique: Hybrid graph extraction: LLM extract then human/expert prune
takeaways.what_they_do: Rather than fully automated LLM graph extraction, they run LLM extraction and then have a domain expert prune relationships, keeping the taxonomy tight so downstream retrieval stays accurate.
takeaways.evidence_quote: after you use the LM to extract your graph you ask the interview the the expert ... to prone the graph

takeaways.technique: Structured quantitative queries over graph instead of vector retrieval
takeaways.what_they_do: They argue vector RAG fails on precise numeric/multi-hop questions and route those to structured graph queries plus function calls, so answers are evidence-based rather than passage-based.
takeaways.evidence_quote: vector store excel ... at sematic sim similarity but struggle with complex numerical calculation
takeaways.numbers: claims 91% accuracy, 85% flexibility, deterministic reproducibility, traceability, scalability (no benchmark detail given)

takeaways.what_they_do: A top 'wisdom agent' oversees sub-agents mapped to states of an explicit state diagram, choosing which model each uses and what to do next based on current situation.
takeaways.evidence_quote: my wisdom agent is now overseeing like a supervisory agent or all these other agent that do ... on the state diagram
